SUBJECT: Your Royalty Summary from BookLeaf Publishing

BODY:
Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well. I am reaching out to provide you with your royalty summary for your published works.

1. Title: Whispers of the Ganges  
   Copies Sold: 342  
   Royalty Earned: ₹11,970  
   Royalty Paid: ₹8,400  
   Royalty Pending: ₹3,570  
   Last Payout Date: 15 Oct 2025  

2. Title: The Saffron Diaries  
   Copies Sold: 189  
   Royalty Earned: ₹7,938  
   Royalty Paid: ₹7,938  
   Royalty Pending: ₹0  
   Last Payout Date: 01 Dec 2025  

Total Earned: ₹19,908  
Total Paid: ₹16,338  
Total Pending: ₹3,570  

I sincerely apologize for the pending balance of ₹3,570 for "Whispers of the Ganges." This amount is being flagged for priority review, and our royalties team will confirm the payout date within 48 hours. I appreciate your patience as we address this matter.

"The Saffron Diaries" is fully paid up, with the earned and paid figures reconciling perfectly, leaving no pending amount for that title. Thank you for your contributions to this work, and we are glad to see it performing well.

Across both titles, you have earned a total of ₹19,908, with ₹16,338 already paid out. The pending amount will roll over to the next quarter, as it is below the minimum payout threshold of ₹1,000. The next quarterly window ends on 31 Dec 2026, with payouts expected by 14 Feb 2027.

If you have any questions regarding these figures or your titles, please feel free to reply to this email. For the overdue balance, we will follow up with you within 48 hours.

Warm regards,  
Team BookLeaf
